tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rdo rje gtum po'i las bzhi'i sbyin sreg 'phrin las 'od kyi 'phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

༄༅// "$ na mo bha ga wān shrī badzra tsaṇḍā ya/ yon tan mtha' dag mthar thug mtshungs pa med pa'i go 'phang mchog zhi ba// brnyes pa khyod kyis srid gsum byon nas sprul pa rnams kyis ni// 'jig rten g.yo bag spyod can re ba'i zhags pa mang pos dam bcings pa// ma lus thugs rjes mya ngan 'das par bkri mdzad rdo rje 'dzin la 'dud// zhi rgyas dbang drag mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub myur du thob par bya ba'i phyir// dpal ldan rdo rje gtum po'i sbyin sreg ni// rgyud dang rgya gzhung ji bzhin bri bar bya// de la 'dir/ dpal rdo rje gtum po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs par thob cing bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i rdo rje 'dzin pas/ rang gzhan gyi don du zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sbyin sreg bya ba la/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi/ rjes dang gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro la las so so'i thab bca' zhing*/ mchod rdzas ji ltar bsham pa dang*/ gnyis las/ dang po ni/ las kyi rdo rje'i rgya gzhung las/ sbyin sreg gi ni cho ga la// khyad par brgyad du shes par bya// zhes gsungs pas/ dus kyi khyad par/ phyogs kyi khyad par/ dbyibs kyi khyad par/ kha dog gi khyad par/ rdzas kyi khyad par/ ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par/ lha'i khyad par/ sngags kyi khyad par dang brgyad las/ dang po dus kyi khyad par ni/ zhi ba la snga dro/ rgyas pa la nyin phyed/ dbang la phyi dro/ drag po la nyi ma nub pa'o// phyogs kyi khyad par ni/ gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud las/ shar du zhi la byang phyogs rgyas pa yin// nub tu dbang la bsad pa lho phyogs yin// zhes gsungs/ dbyibs kyi khyad par ni/ gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud las/ sbyang ba la sogs sngon 'gro bas// zhes gsungs pas/ sa ma dul bar sa chog sogs tshar ba'i rjes su sgrub khang gi phyogs so sor khru do dang ldan pa'i stegs bu gru bzhir byas pa'i dbus su thig chen brgyad btab la/

gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud las/ zhi ba'i thab kyi tshad sor bcu bzhi/ dbus phyag len la nas mtho gang zlum por bskor ba'i khru gang gi tshad kyi phyir mu ran dang kha khyer sor bzhi pa re'i mthar stegs bu'i dod du sor lnga'i tshad gru bzhir btab pa'i phyir shun pa sor gnyis pa'i zur bzhir zla phyed/ rdo rjes mtshan par bris pa'i lte bar 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad lte ba la sum cha rtsibs la sum gnyis yod pa'i shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ mtshams bzhi ji ltar mdzes pa'i lte ba sngon po la/ rdo rje mthing nag rtse lnga pa/ shar du 'khor lo dkar po/ lhor rin po che ser po/ nub tu padma dmar po/ byang du ral gri ljang khu/ mu ran la padma'i 'phyang dang*/ kha khyer la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba bri/ rgyas pa la gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud nas sor bcu dbus phyag len la nas khru gang gi tshad zur thig bzhi'i steng du mtshan ma bya/ de'i steng du gru bzhi bzhir btab pas khru do'i tshad du gyur pa'i phyir mu ran dang kha khyer sor brgyad pa/ mu ran la padma'i 'phyang dang*/ kha khyer dang 'khor lo'i lte bar rin po ches mtshan pa/ dbang dbang ldan nas la sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad dbus phyag len la nas zlum por bskor ba'i ngos gcig thig gis bcad la zla gam du byas pa'i phyir mu ran dang kha khyer sor bzhi pa'i mu ran la padma'i 'phyang dang kha khyer la lcags kyu dang 'khor lo'i lte bar padmas mtshan pa/ drag po gsang bstan las sor brgyad la sor mo nyi shu'i phyag len la tshad gru gsum du btab pa'i mu ran dang kha khyer sor gsum pa'i mu ran la padma'i 'phyang dang*/ kha khyer dang 'khor lo'i lte bar ral gris mtshan pa/ stegs bu'i mtshams bzhir yang las dang mthun pa'i phyag mtshan so so'i kha dog bzhin rdul tshon gyis bri'o// bud shing gi rgyu/ zhi ba la 'o ma can gyi shing*/ dkar ba rtse mo'i cha las byung ba'am/

srog chags med pa'i ba glang gi lci ba skam po dri bzang gis chus byugs pa/ rgyas pa la 'bras bu can ser po dbus kyi cha las byung ba/ dbang la kha dog dmar po/ ro skyur ba smad kyi cha las byung ba/ drag po la nag po gyong ba rtsa ba'i cha las byung ba'o// zhi ba la rgyar khru gang dpangs su khru phyed pa zlum por brtsig rgyas pa la rgyar khru do dpangs su khru gang gru bzhir brtsig dbang la/ rgyar khru gang dpangs su khru phyed zla gam du brtsig drag po la rgyar sor nyi shu/ dpangs su sor bcu gru gsum du brtsig cing*/ de dag so so'i kha dog gi khyad par yang*/ gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud las/ dkar ser dmar nag ljang khu ste// las dang 'brel bar shes par bya// zhes gsungs pas/ zhi ba la kha dog dkar po/ rgyas pa la kha dog ser po/ dbang la kha dog dmar po/ drag po la kha dog nag po'am ljang khur bya'o// de rnams ni bris thab kyi dbang du byas pa yin la/ brtsig thab dang*/ brkos thab gang byed kyang rgya tshad dang dpangs/ mu ran dang kha khyer/ dbyibs dang kha dog sogs phyag len bzhin no// gnyis pa mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas bsham pa ni/ gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud las/ mchod pa'i rdzas dang yam shing dang*// dūr ba la sogs bsreg pa'i rdzas// g.yas dang g.yon gyi rim pa yin// zhes gsungs pas/ rang gi mdun du cog rtse la sogs pa'i khar rdo rje dril bu dgang blugs bdud rtsi rnams bzhag cing*/ zhi rgyas dbang gsum la g.yas phyogs su/ chu bzhi bzed zhal dang bcas pa'i mchod pa rnam lnga dang*/ g.yon phyogs su/ bsreg rdzas/ mar khu til/ yungs kar/ yam shing*/ 'bras/ dkar gsum mngar gsum/ zho zan dūr ba/ ku sha so ba/ nas/ mā sha gro/ gtor ma me dar dang bcas pa ste/ drag po de las ldog la bsham par bya'o// zhi ba la rang rgyan dang chas gos dkar pos bya/ rgyas pa la ser po/ dbang la dmar po/ drag po la nag po bya zhing*/ zhi ba la tsog pu'i 'dug stangs/

rgyas pa la bzang po'i 'dug stangs/ dbang la padma'i/ drag po la khro bo'i 'dug stangs kyis bya zhing*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par ni/ gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud las/ rang nyid rdo rje 'dzin par bskyed// rgyas la dga' dang zhi la zhi// dbang la chags dang bsad la khro// zhes gsungs ba'i bsam pa dang ldan pas/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub mchod ma 'brel na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas gzung mchod pa byin rlabs yan bya/ 'brel na bsrung 'khor yan bzhag la chu dang mchod pa byin rlabs kyi rjes su/ sreg rdzas rnams a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du bsreg rdzas rnams ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mar khu/ til/ yungs kar/ yam shing*/ 'bras/ dkar gsum mngar gsum/ zho zan/ dūr ba/ ku sha so ba/ nas/ mā sha gro la sogs pa rnam pa sreg rdzas so sor snang zhing*/ ngo bo zag med kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin las so so sgrub pa la thogs pa med par gyur/ zhes rdzas so so la dgang blugs reg cing sngags lan gsum gsum brjod pa'i rjes su oṃ ā swāhā/ oṃ shrīṃ swāhā/ oṃ dzriṃ swāhā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ lan gsum brjod cing*/ thab byin brlab ni/ spos dkar dang sha chen sogs kyi dud pa gtong zhing rol mo'i sgra sgrog bzhin par/ pheṃ pheṃ dzaḥhūm̐ dharma ka ka kītti raṃ zhes pa nas/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ'i bar lan gsum brjod pas/ bla ma gtum po 'khor dang bcas pa sprin gtibs pa bzhin byon nas byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha la sreg blugs 'bul ba la/ gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thab bskyed pa ni/ a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā wa 'am/ shū n+ya tās sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag gi thugs ka nas hūm̐ dkar po gcig thab tu 'phros pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar zhing zlum pa/

rgyar khru gang*/ dpangs su khru phyed pa/ mu ran dang kha khyer sor bzhi pa/ mu ran la padma'i 'phyang dang*/ kha khyer la rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ thab kyi nang du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte ba dang phyogs kyi rtsibs la rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyis mtshan pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa ye shes kyi snang ba las grub par gyur/ rgyas pa la/ bdag gi thugs ka nas hūm̐ ser po 'phros pa sogs zhi ba dang 'dra zhing*/ rgyas pa'i thab khung ser po gru bzhi pa/ rgyar khru do dpangs su khru gang pa/ mu ran dang kha khyer sor brgyad pa/ mu ran la padma'i 'phyang dang*/ kha khyer la rin po che'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ thab kyi nang du 'khor lo ser po rtsibs brgyad nas/ ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i bar gsum ka la 'gre/ dbang gi thab khung dmar po zla gam rgyar khru gang dpangs su khru phyed/ mu ran dang kha khyer sor bzhi pa/ mu ran la padma'i 'phyang dang*/ kha khyer la lcags kyu'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ drag po'i thab khung nag po gru gsum pa rgyar sor nyi shu dang*/ dpangs su sor bcu pa/ mu ran dang kha khyer sor gsum pa/ mu ran la khro bo'i rdo rje dang*/ kha khyer la ral gri'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ 'jigs su rung zhing skyi g.ya' ba'i gnas su gyur/ me blang zhing gzhug pa ni/ zhi ba la bram ze'i khyim nas blangs/ rgyas pa la rgyal po'i khyim nas/ dbang la smad 'tshong ma'i khyim nas/ drag po la gshan pa'i khyim nas me blangs la shing skam mam rtswa'i chun po ras mar gyis sbags pa dkris pa bsangs sbyangs byas/ zhi rgyas dbang gsum la thab kyi kha la g.yas bskor dang*/ drag po la g.yon bskor byas te/ zhi ba la oṃ badzra dzwa la hūm̐ zhes shar nas gzhug /rgyas pa la byang nas/ dbang la nub nas/ drag po la hūm̐ badzra dzwa la hūm̐ zhes lho nas gzhug cing*/ me ma 'bar na rlung g.yab kyis g.yab cing*/

oṃ agna ye swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis zhi rgyas dbang gsum la mar dang*/ drag po la mar nag blugs gzar gsum thab tu blug pas me gsol la/ ku sha gsar pa sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa/ ma gas shing 'dab ma ma grug pa ha cang yang mi ring ba'i chun po bsang sbyang byas la/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes de snying po'i mchog /dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed de// tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin// bdag gi bgegs rnams ma lus pa// zhi zhing bkra shis mdzad du gsol// oṃ badzra sa twa aḥzhes pas zhi rgyas dbang gsum la/ chun po gnyis mdun nas g.yas bskor du shar gyi rtse mo lhor bstan/ gnyis lho'i rtse mo nub tu/ gnyis nub kyi rtse mo byang*/ gnyis byang gi rtse mo shar du bstan pa dang*/ drag po la de las bzlog ste g.yon bskor du stegs bu'i khar dgram/ chun po che ba gcig thab kyi steng du rtse mo shar du bstan la bzhag pa ni me lha'i gdan du bsam mo// bskyed pa lha'i khyad par ni/ thab kyi dbus su pad nyi'i gdan la/ bdag gi thugs ka nas hūm̐ dkar po gcig 'phros/ rdo rje gtum po yab yum gnyis su gyur nas snyoms par zhugs pas 'od zhu ba las byung ba'i drang srong me lha sku mdog dkar po zhi ba'i nyams can zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas dang po dbyug tho dang*/ gnyis pa na spyi blugs/ g.yon dang po bgrang 'phreng dang*/ gnyis pa na me thab bsnams pa/ ral pa'i cod pan dang bsus khyim che ba/ spyan gsum pa sma ra dang ag tshom can/ rin po che dang tshangs skud la sogs pas brgyan pa/ rgyas pa la bdag gi thugs ka nas hūm̐ ser po 'phros/ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i drang srong me lha sku mdog ser po brjid pa'i nyams can/ dbang la bdag gi thugs ka nas hūm̐ dmar po 'phros/ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i drang srong me lha sku mdog dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/ drag po la bdag gi thugs ka nas hūm̐ nag po 'phros/

'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i drang srong me lha sku mdog nag po khros pa'i nyams can/ gzhan mngon rtogs gong bzhin bskyed pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs khar hūm̐/ hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas me mtshams nas ye shes kyi me lha badzra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje dril bu spos dang bcas pa bzung la/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /sreg blug zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod// oṃ agna ye de wa ta ā karṣā ya dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang bskur gyi lha spyan drangs/ de rnams kyi dbang bskur/ dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ zhi ba la rnam snang*/ rgyas pa la rin 'byung*/ dbang la snang mtha'/ drag po la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud las/ bsang gtor thor 'thung mchod yon dang*// zhabs bsil la sogs dbul bar bya// me tog la sogs rim pas te// gzar bu gnyis kyi mar khu dbul// de rjes me yi mtshan ma brtag /ces gsungs pas/ thog mar mchod yon dbul ba ni/ oṃ agna ye de wa ta arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swāhā/ zhes pas mchod yon 'bul/ pādyaṃ gyis zhabs bsil/ añtsa mā nāṃ gyis zhal bsil/ prokṣa ṇaṃ gyis bsang gtor phul la/ oṃ agna ye de wa ta puṣpe pra tītstsha hūm̐ swāhā/ zhes sogs rnam lngas mchod/ me lha'i ljags dang dgang blugs kyi kha la raṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ agna ye swāhā/ zhi rgyas dbang gsum la mar dang*/ drag po la mar nag dgang blugs kha sbyar ba lag pa gnyis pus mo las phyir mi 'da' bar thab kyi kha la g.yas skor bdun dang*/ drag po la pus mo'i phyi nas g.yon skor gyis bdun phul la/ me pra brtag pa ni/ gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud las/ mdog dang sgra dang dri dang ro// dbyibs dang kha dog blta bar bya// me ni rtse gcig 'bar gyur na// bsam pa thams cad 'grub par ston// gnyis 'bar rtse gsum mi g.yo na// 'bar ba'i 'bras bu thams cad 'byin// rtse bzhi mnyam zhing brtan pa ste// rgyas pa'i las la 'bras bu yod// zla 'dra snum la dri ma med// du ba med cing baiḍūr 'dra// nad med rigs rnams rgyas pa yin// chu shel nor bu spungs pa dang*// padma rā ga gsal ba yis// sdig pa ma lus zad par 'gyur// dmar ser puṇḍa rī ka dang*// bandhu'i kha dog gsal ba dang*// rgyal srid dpal rnams 'byor pa yin// utpal ma li u shi dri// tsam pa ka dang pi kar dri// ga pur a ka ru yi dris// dge zhing tshe ring dpal gyi gnas// zab pa'i skad dang dung dang ni// rdza rnga pi waṃ ḍa ma ru'i// de yi sgras ni bde ba 'phel// dpal be'u bkra shis rdzas su 'char// rgyal mtshan rnga yab phyag mtshan rnams// rin chen gdugs kyi dbyibs su 'bar// dge ba'i me yi dbyibs su bstan// ngan pa de las ci rigs bzlog

/ngan na bzlog pa'i thabs kyang bya// bsreg bya rdzas kyi khyad par ni/ brtag gnyis las/ zhi la til dang rgyas la zho// dbang dang dgug la utpal la// sdang dang bsad la tsher mar brjod// ces gsungs pas/ zhi ba la til dang yungs kar 'bras dang mar dkar thog mar 'bul/ rgyas pa la/ bud shing gi rgyu las byung ba'i yam shing*/ zhi ba la/ byang chub shing dang 'o ma can/ rgyas pa la/ go la'i shing dang*/ n+ya gro ta/ dbang la/ tsan dan dmar po dang*/ rgya shug gong ma gsum la rtsi mar gyis sbags pa dang*/ rgyas pa la yam shing dang*/ zho zan/ rin po che sna lnga/ 'bru lnga thog mar 'bul/ dbang la sman gyi bye brag me tog dmar po'i rigs dkar gsum mngar gsum thog mar 'bul/ drag po la seng dang*/ tsher nag zur gsum pa rtse gnyis rno ba khrag gis byugs pa la gnod byed kyi ming byang bris pa'i yam shing dang*/ dgra la byed na ro ras dang*/ bgegs la shog bu la dug khrag gam ro sol gyi snag tshas rang gi dri ma song bar byas la/ lidga shin tu rid pa yan lag lcags sgrog gis bsdams pa gcig bris pa'i dpral bar rus/ snying khar ming*/ gsang gnas su bla gdags sogs phyag len bzhin bris pa'am/ khrag las sbrus pa'i zan gyi lidga yang rung ste/ sbyangs khrus sogs legs par byas pa/ lcags kyi snod dam brub khung du bcug la dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ rang gtum por gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i khro bo dang khyung mang po spros pa'i phyag na lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu bsnams pa dpag tu med pa dgra bgegs gang na yod pa nas sprul pa'i pho nya de rnams kyis lcags kyus snying nas bzung*/ zhags pas rke nas bcings/ lcags sgrog gis yan lag bsdams/ dril bus lus sems myos par byas/ rang dbang med par byi'u khras bdas pa bzhin bkug la ling ga la bstim/ lus kyi phyag rgya bzhi byed cing*/ ngag nas bden pa'i stobs brjod la/ nṛ tri sha truṃ bighannā/

oṃ badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ.oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badzra ā be sha ya aḥ.ā karṣa ya dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod cing*/ yid kyis dgra bgegs gang yin ling ga la yang yang du thim par bsam pa ni dgug gzhug bya ba'o// lha dang dbye ba la/ 'jig rten pa'i lha dang dbye ba dang*/ ye shes kha sbyar dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ khyi lud/ phag brun/ yugs sa'i zhab ma/ mdze pho'i lahwam 'bob/ mu zi nag po/ sgog skya/ ra'i rwa gzhob/ rta bon pa rnams kyi dud pas/ ling ga man ngag ltar bdug cing*/ gu gul gcig pos yang bdug par bshad/ de nas gtor ma byin la bden pa bdar/ sarba sha truṃ utstsha ṭā ya hūm̐ phaṭ ces brjod la phyi'i rgya mtsho'i mthar bskrad cing*/ gnyis pa ni/ rang rdo rje gtum po'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i sku gsung thugs las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas kho'i sgo gsum gyi dwangs ma ye shes kyi lha dang bcas pa thams cad rdo khab len gyis lcags bsdus pa bzhin/ rang gi gnas gsum du 'ub kyis bsdus nas skye ba med pa'i ngang la mnyam par 'jog go /thun gyis bsad pa ni/ lcags sam thod pa mtshan ngan gyi snod du thun rdzas rdo phye/ lcags phye zangs phye/ yungs kar/ ke tshe/ shang tshe de skam thun dang*/ rlon thun dug chu dang*/ dug khrag la oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭ/ ga ru ṭa de wa then phyung*/ dgra la byed na sarba sha trūṃ/ bgegs la byed na sarba bighnān/ klu la nā ga'i snying la gzer/ gnod byed 'byung po thum ril li rbad/ na ga tsaṇḍa tshal pa utga te/ nā ga tsitta shakti tshal pa nan/ nā ga trī ta sa ma ya a tri bighnān ha/ nā ga kro dha pi ta ra dzā ya/ gnod byed thams cad mā ra ya shi shi/ nan nan/ dul dul/ rbud rbud/ gnod byed pho mo thum ril li li dzaḥ las sngags 'di rnams mang du bzlas la gdab skam thun rlon gyis ling ga la brab pa ni thun gyis bsad pa'o// de nas lcags sam seng ldeng gi phur pa bsangs sbyangs byas/

stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje gtum po sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje tho ba nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon mi rus kyi phur pa bsgril ba/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing spyan gsum me stag gi phung po ltar dmar ba/ dbu skra dang ag tshom smin ma kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ sbrul rigs lngas brgyan pa/ sku'i lte ba man gnam lcags las grub pa'i phur pa me nang nas bton ma thag lta bu rno dbal dang ldan pa/ me 'bar bar gyur pa'i spyi bor oṃ las zhes pa nas dbang bskur bas mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ bdun rnam dag dang bstod pa byas/ me tog la rten 'brel snying po bzlas la gtor zhing rang gi lag pa g.yas pas rdo rje nam mkhar 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas phur bu bzung la/ gong gi las sngags kyi rjes su phur sngags/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba duṣṭāṃ bighnān hūm̐ phaṭ/ kī la ya kī la ya badzra dhā ra ā dzñā pa ya ti/ kā ya wā k tsitta badzra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭ ces bzlas shing*/ ling ga'i snying ga sogs gnas lnga yan lag bzhi rnams su phur pa 'debs shing*/ g.yas rdo rje tho bas phur bu'i mgo nas brdung zhing*/ oṃ badzra mudga ra badzra kī la ya a ko ṭa hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces pa ni phur pas bsad pa'o// mtshon rnon po gzhan gyis kyang gtubs la dmigs bya'i sha khrag tu bsam de sreg rdzas dang bsres pa dang*/ gzhan yang ling ga brgya rtsa brgyad/ sha chen/ lan tshwa dug dang khrag nyung nag ke tshe/ tshil chen la sogs pa gtso bor 'bul ba'o// sngags kyi khyad par ni/ sngags gang gis 'bul na/ sngags gcig gis rdzas thams cad 'bul ba dang*/ sngags so sos rdzas tha dad 'bul ba sogs bshad kyang*/ 'dir rdzas re dang sngags re spel nas mthun par 'bul te/ lha sngags/ rdzas sngags/ las sngags gsum sbrel nas 'bul ba ni/ rdzas thun mong ba'i dang po zhi rgyas dbang gsum la mar khu dang*/

drag po la mar nag 'bul te/ oṃ agna ye de wa ta agna ye swāhā/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shintaṃ ku ru swāhā/ bdun 'bul/ zhi ba la/ oṃ agna ye de wa ta sarba pā paṃ da ha na badzra ye swāhā/ bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad shīntaṃ ku ru swāhā/ til/ yungs kar gyi yang de nyid do// gnod par byed pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad dang*/ oṃ agna ye de wa ta yan thams cad la 'gre zhing*/ sarba pā paṃ gyi gnas su/ oṃ bo dhi brikṣa ya swāhā/ byang chub kyi shing ngo*// oṃ badzra ya dzñā ya swāhā/ u dum wa ra'i 'o// oṃ badzra be rā ya swāhā/ n+ya gro ta'i/ oṃ gā ta ya swāhā/ seng ldeng gi sngags so// yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi ces pa yan thams cad la 'gre ba las/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swāhā/ yam shing ngo*// oṃ badzra puṣṭa ye swāhā/ khyim dang 'byor pa rgyas pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swāhā/ 'bras ma grugs pa'i 'o// bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru zhes thams cad la 'gre/ oṃ du dhu da dhi ma dhu re swāhā/ shes rab 'phel ba la/ dkar gsum mngar gsum mo// oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swāhā/ bde ba rgyas pa la/ zho zan no// oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba la/ dūrba'o// oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ya swāhā/ bsrung ba phun sum tshogs pa la/ ku sha'o// oṃ badzra bi dzā ya swāhā/ nor dang 'bru rnams rgyas pa la/ 'bras so ba'o// oṃ ma hā be gā ya swāhā/ lus kyi shugs rgyas pa la/ nas so/ oṃ ma hā bā lā ya swāhā/ lus kyi stobs rgyas pa la/ mon sran gre'u 'o// oṃ badzra ghasma ri swāhā/ nad med pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru swāhā/

gro'o// rdzas rnams grangs bdun bdun phul la/ rgyas pa la/ mar khu la 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ sdig pa dang bral ba'i phun sum tshogs pa puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa thams cad= khyim dang 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad= shes rab phun sum tshogs pa thams cad= bde ba phun sum tshogs pa thams cad= tshe dang bsod nams sum tshogs pa thams cad= bsrung ba phun sum tshogs pa thams cad= nor dang 'bru phun sum tshogs pa thams cad= lus shugs phun sum tshogs pa thams cad= lus kyi stobs phun sum tshogs pa thams cad= nad med pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ dbang la phun sum tshogs pa thams cad wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes thams cad la sbyar zhing*/ drag po la/ phun sum tshogs pa la gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad ma ra ya phaṭ/ ces gzhug par bya'o// de yang*/ gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud las/ khu ba la sogs rdzas rnams ni// lha yi zhal du mchod par bya// yam shing ku sha la sogs pa// 'od la mchod par bya ba yin// zhal du zhal zas thor 'thung dbul// me tog bdug spos dbu dang 'od// byug pa snying khar bsang gtor bya// sku la phul te zhabs bsil zhabs// mar me la sogs rim bzhin gnas// gtor ma zhal dang gos zung na bzar 'bul// zhes pa dang*/ yang de nyid las/ bstod cing gsol ba'i las bya ste// zhes gsungs pas/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ 'jigs byed chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad sbyin mdzad pa// bdag gzhan don la rab tu brtson// drang srong chen po nyid la 'dud/ hūm̐ las skyes pa'i drang srong chen po ni// sku mdog dkar po zhi ba'i nyams ldan zhing*/ rgyas pa la/ sku mdog ser po brjid pa'i nyams ldan zhing*// dbang la/ sku mdog dmar po chags pa'i nyams ldan zhing*/ drag po la/ sku mdog nag po khros pa'i nyams ldan zhing*// zhes 'don pa bsgyur ro// zhal gcig spyan gsum ral pa'i thor tshugs can// phyag bzhi g.yas gnyis dbyug tho spyi blugs dang*// g.yon pa bgrang 'phreng me thab 'dzin mdzad cing*// rin chen tshangs skud sogs kyis rab brgyan zhing*// 'dod pa'i don rnams sgrub par byed pa yi// drang srong byin za nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod cing*/

'phrin las bcol ba ni/ zhi rgyas dbang gsum la mar dang*/ drag po la mar nag dgang blug gsum phul la/ zhi ba la/ drang srong chen po khyed la sreg rdzas phul ba la brten nas/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ bla ma gong ma chos kyi dbyings su gshegs pa'i rnam dkar gyi dgongs pa rdzogs shing*/ zhal bzhugs sku tshe brtan zhing*/ sems can thams cad la bde skyid rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib la sogs thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa bsgrub pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ rgyas pa la/ tshe dang bsod nams/ stobs dang gzi brjid/ dpal dang 'byor pa la sogs 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ dbang la/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten/ nang bcud kyi sems can/ khyad par lha 'dre mi gsum nor dang longs spyod la sogs mdor na/ snang mi snang thams cad dbang du bsdu bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ drag po la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang smad pa/ dge 'dun gyi sde bcom pa/ khyad par bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa dam pa'i chos bsgrub cing nyams su len pa la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs/ snga dgra lag la bdar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra dngos su sbyor ba'i che ge mo zhes bya ba drag po'i las kyis tshar bcad nas yang dag pa'i lam la 'god par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing*/ rdzas rnams phul ba'i rjes su byas na'ang legs par sem mo/ gnyis pa gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud las/ me lha'i snying gar dkyil 'khor mchod// bsang gtor la sogs rim pa bzhin// sngar bstan pa las shes par bya// zhes gsungs pas/ a mṛ tas bsangs/

swā bhā was sbyangs/ me lha snying ga yangs pa'i dbus su bhruṃ yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang*/ zhes pa nas/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab kyi bar gzhung bzhin la/ byon skyems snying po so so'i zhabs su oṃ agna ye swāhā/ zhes btags pas las dang mthun pa'i mar ram mar nag gtso bo la nyi shu rtsa gcig dang 'khor rnams la bdun phul la/ phyag 'tshal gyi rjes su mchod pa rgyas pa'am/ bsdus pa/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥ arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swāhā/ zhes sogs chu bzhi dang phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ gsang mchod/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa rang rdzas mdzes pa'i bar phyi rol mchod chog bzhin la/ de nas bsreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ bī ra badzra su khī hūm̐ phaṭ/ yab yum gyi snying po nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ sa ma ya oṃ ga ru ḍa hūm̐ zhes rgyas par bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i khyung gi bar dang*/ bsdus pa khyad par gyi 'khor bzhi/ khyung lnga sogs kyi snying po'i zhabs su rdzas sngags so so btags pa me lha'i skabs bzhin spel tshig dang bcas pas/ gtso bo yab yum la brgya dang brgyad phul na 'khor rnams la nyi shu rtsa gcig re 'bul/ gtso bo yab yum la nyi shu rtsa gcig phul na/ 'khor rnams la bdun bdun/ gtso bo yab yum la bdun phul na 'khor rnams la gsum gsum 'bul ba sogs rgyas bsdus kyi bye brag shes pa gal che zhing*/ gtor ma gzhung bzhin phul la/ gos zung 'bul ba ni/ bsangs sbyangs byas la/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos// mi phyed rdo rje'i sku brnyes la// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ badzra wast+rā ya swāhā/ zhes brjod cing*/ las dang mthun pa'i so rtsi mar ram mar nag dgang blugs gang*/ oṃ badzra tāmbul la ye swāhā/ zhes pas phul la/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba 'debs pa'ang*/

rdo rje gtum po'i lha tshogs rnams la sreg rdzas phul ba la brten nas/ zhes sogs me lha'i skabs bzhin bya'o// de nas/ bdag gis thog ma med dus nas// zhes sogs rgyun bshags dang*/ bstod pa ni/ 'gro ba kun gyi dpal gyur pa// zhes pa nas/ thogs med rdo rje khyod la 'dud// zhes pa'i bar ram/ yang na/ gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud las gsungs pa'i mtshan nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bstod la/ yig brgya lan gsum bzlas rjes/ dam pa rje btsun pa zhes pa nas/ drag po'i las kyis tshar gcod nus par byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes pa'i bar phyi rol mchod chog bzhin bya'o// gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud las/ dkyil 'khor bsdu gshegs rim pa rnams// mkhas pas nye bar brtags te bya// zhes gsungs pas dkyil 'khor dang me lha gnyis ka'i gshegs bsdu bstan pa yin gsung ngo*// de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ lha tshogs rnams la mchod bstod bsdus pa cig phul la/ gshegs skyems las dang mthun pa'i mar ram mar nag gtso bo la nyi shu rtsa gcig dang*/ 'khor rnams la bdun bdun phul la yi ge brgya pa lan gsum bzlas pas lhag chad bskang nas/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// ces pa nas/ bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra pā ṇi maṇḍal muḥ ces brjod pas/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang 'brel na mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa dkyil 'khor du gshegs shing*/ ma 'brel na ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs pa'am/ dam tshig ye shes dbyer med pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa bdag gi thugs kar thim pas/ bdag dang gnyis su med par bsam zhing*/ gsum pa rjes me lha la gtang rag gi mchod sbyin dang phan yon bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mar ram mar nag dgang blugs gsum thab tu blugs pas/ drang srong me lha zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa skad cig gis gsal bar gyur/

chu bzhi mchod pa lnga dang sreg rdzas rnams gong bzhin bdun bdun phul rjes gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma zag med kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ agna ye de wa ta i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi zhes gsum mam lngas phul la/ gos zung bsangs sbyangs byas la/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra ba// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyang phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog /oṃ badzra wastā ya swāhā zhes brjod cing*/ so rtsi mar ram mar nag dgang blugs gang*/ oṃ badzra tāmbu lā ye swāhā/ zhes pas phul la/ bstod pa dang 'phrin las bcol ba'i bar sngar bzhin byas la/ slar mchod bstod bsdus pa'i rjes su/ gshegs skyems/ mar ram mar nag dgang blugs gsum phul la/ yig brgya lan gsum bzlas pas lhag chad bskang*/ nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis mdzad lags kyi// rang gnas bde bar gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// oṃ agna ye de wa ta gatstsha swa bhā wā nāṃ/ zhes pas ye shes kyi me lha shar lhor gshegs/ dam tshig gi me lha bdag gi thugs kar bsdu zhing*/ sreg rdzas lhag ma rnams thab tu blug la/ oṃ agna ye swāhā/ zhes brjod pas 'gro ba rigs drug thams cad der 'dus nas rang rang gi 'dod yon gyis tshim par bsam zhing*/ me de long yod na ma shi'i bar bzhag long med na zhi ba la 'o ma sogs dkar po'i dri'i chu dang*/ rgyas pa la ser po'o// dbang la dmar po'o// drag po la dug khrag gi chus gzhil la/ de nas thal sol rnams las thams cad pa'i bum par blug la/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du dor la slar chu gtsang gis bkang ba khyer nas sbyin sreg khang par gtor zhing las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// gnyis pa rjes phan yon bstan pa ni/

gsang ba bstan pa'i rgyud las// dkyil 'khor lhas ni mchog ster la// me yis 'dod pa'i don sgrub byed// yan lag gis ni bde ba sbyin// 'o ma sbrang rtsis bde ba 'phel// gro dang sran mas nad kun sel// dūrbas srog ni 'dzin pa yin// nas kyis brtson 'grus la dbang ste// stobs 'phel mā sha ka yin no// 'bru 'phel so ba'i las yin te// sdig pa dag pa til yin no// 'bras kyis nus pa 'phel byed la// zhi ba yungs dkar ku shas bsrung*// dpal bskyed pa ni bud shing ste// yam shing gzi brjid skyed par byed// 'byor pa 'phel ba mar yin ni// sbyin bdag bkra shis thab yin no// dngos grub kun ster mchod pa'i rdzas// thabs dang shes rab gzar bu ste// bdud kyi mar gyis tshim byed pa// mchod pa gzhan gyis ci zhig bya// zhes gsungs so// de ltar rdo rje gtum po'i las bzhi'i sbyin bsreg 'phrin las 'od kyi 'phreng ba 'di nyid/ tshul 'di nyid kyi bsnyen bsgrub la lhag par brtson pa sngags 'chang chos kyi mgon po dang*/ grub chen shākya'i mtshan can gyi rigs kyi dbon brgyud chos la nges par som zhing blo mig yangs pa bla ma rgya mtshos nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dpal ldan 'brug pa rin po che'i ring lugs dri ma med pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa ngag dbang nor bus/ khro mo zhes pa shing pho 'brug gi lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i dmar cha 'phel ba'i dga' ba dang po'i rgyal dang phur bu 'dzom pa'i dus sbyor bzang po la/ gdan sa chen po ra lung thil gyi kun dga' ra ba chos kyi 'byung gnas dam par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa'ang gu ru sā ga ra nyid kyis bgyis pa'i dge bas 'phrin las bzhi bde blag tu 'grub ste rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob par gyur cig// /madgalaṃ/// /
